scope: lane message relay between Claude Code and Codex sessions
reasons: Used as the design reference for packs/lanes/scripts/lane-bus.py: a Claude Code plugin monitor that polls an inbox, and a Codex client that resumes a thread through app-server.

Its model is many agents in an open room with telemetry on by default; the lane model is one seat per harness with retirement on handoff and the lane provenance tag, so a mapping layer would be as large as the prototype and would follow upstream changes.
Its Codex path drives the thread from its own app-server; with the desktop app's embedded app-server that makes two writers on one thread, which the prototype does not do.
revisit_when: Codex offers a supported way to wake an idle desktop thread, or the lane model grows beyond one seat per harness.

license: MIT with a rider (GitHub reports NOASSERTION)
scope: agent mailbox MCP server for lane messages
reasons: The license adds a rider that names OpenAI and Anthropic as restricted parties, so it is not the permissive license the import protocol requires.
It is a full server with its own storage and web UI, far beyond the 200-line integration limit for a feature that one SQLite file covers.
revisit_when: The rider is removed and a lane needs more than direct seat-to-seat messages.
